why: Image 2 reads as a real room on a long exposure: the record shelves are actually full, the crop is tighter and more editorial, and the motion-blurred figures suggest a bar in use, even though the ghosts look a little too transparent. Image 1 has mostly empty cubbies, a row of identical stools, too-even haze beams and flat, synthetic wood, so it looks like a CG visualization rather than a photograph.
